actions.rabbitmq_get_queue_info.descript: Gets the message and consumer count of a queue.
actions.rabbitmq_list_bindings.descripti: Lists the bindings in the connected virtual host.
actions.rabbitmq_list_bindings.props.exc: Optional. Only return bindings whose source is this exchange.
actions.rabbitmq_list_exchanges.descript: Lists the exchanges in the connected virtual host.
actions.rabbitmq_list_queues.description: Lists the queues in the connected virtual host.
actions.rabbitmq_publish_to_exchange.des: Publishes a message to an exchange with a routing key.
actions.rabbitmq_publish_to_exchange.pro: MIME type set on the message. Defaults to application/json, or text/plain when the data is plain text.
Exact name of an existing exchange.
Optional message headers as a JSON object, for example {"source": "activepieces"}.
Message body. A valid JSON string is sent as application/json, anything else as text/plain.
Ask the broker to write the message to disk so it survives a broker restart (only on durable queues).
Routing key, for example orders.created. Leave empty for fanout exchanges.
actions.rabbitmq_publish_to_queue.descri: Publishes a message directly to a queue.
MIME type set on the message. Defaults to application/json, or text/plain when the data is plain text.
Optional message headers as a JSON object, for example {"source": "activepieces"}.
Message body. A valid JSON string is sent as application/json, anything else as text/plain.
Ask the broker to write the message to disk so it survives a broker restart (only on durable queues).
Exact name of an existing queue.
actions.sendMessageToExchange.descriptio: Send a message on a RabbitMQ exchange
actions.sendMessageToExchange.props.cont: MIME type set on the message. Defaults to application/json, or text/plain when the data is plain text.
actions.sendMessageToExchange.props.exch: The name of the exchange to send the message to
actions.sendMessageToExchange.props.head: Optional message headers as a JSON object, for example {"source": "activepieces"}.
Headers
actions.sendMessageToExchange.props.pers: Ask the broker to write the message to disk so it survives a broker restart (only on durable queues).
actions.sendMessageToExchange.props.rout: The routing key to use when sending the message
actions.sendMessageToQueue.description: Send a message on a RabbitMQ queue
actions.sendMessageToQueue.props.content: MIME type set on the message. Defaults to application/json, or text/plain when the data is plain text.
actions.sendMessageToQueue.props.headers: Optional message headers as a JSON object, for example {"source": "activepieces"}.
actions.sendMessageToQueue.props.persist: Ask the broker to write the message to disk so it survives a broker restart (only on durable queues).
actions.sendMessageToQueue.props.queue.d: The name of the queue to send the message to. It must already exist.
auth.description: Connect to your RabbitMQ broker over AMQP. Add the Management API URL to let AI agents list queues, exchanges and bindings.
auth.props.host.description: Broker host name or IP, without scheme or port (for example rabbitmq.example.com).
auth.props.managementUrl.description: Optional. Base URL of the RabbitMQ Management plugin (for example http://localhost:15672). Uses the same username and password.
auth.props.port.description: AMQP port. Usually 5672, or 5671 with TLS.
auth.props.useTls.description: Connect with TLS. Most hosted brokers require this.
auth.props.vhost.description: Virtual host name. Leave empty for the default "/".
triggers.messageReceived.description: Triggers when a message is received on a RabbitMQ queue
triggers.messageReceived.props.maxMessag: The maximum number of messages to fetch per poll
triggers.messageReceived.props.queue.des: The name of the queue to listen to
